from legal_skill_guard.openexempt import evaluate
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
root=Path.cwd();rd=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text());run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03"
cfgpath=root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json";cfg=rd(cfgpath)
packet=root/cfg["input_packet"];rows=rd(packet)["rows"];row_by={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in rows}
bank=[];latest={};audits=[];origins={};targets={};evidence={str(cfgpath.relative_to(root)),str(packet.relative_to(root))}
total=0;rescued_total=0

 messages,schema,_=actor_payload(row,book,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 return {"messages":messages,"schema":schema,"generation":cfg["generation"]}

 if path not in origins:origins[path]=rd(root/path)
 return origins[path]
for batch in range(1,9):
 pubpath=run/f"publications/b{batch}.json";pub=rd(pubpath)
 firstpath=run/f"batches/b{batch}_prequential_records.json";first=rd(firstpath)
 evidence.update((str(pubpath.relative_to(root)),str(firstpath.relative_to(root))))
 assert pub["parent_bank_sha256"]==csha(bank)
 current=[r for r in rows if r["batch"]==batch];seen=[r for r in rows if r["batch"]<=batch]
 current_ids={r["case_id"] for r in current}
 observations={**latest,**{(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in first["skills"]}}
 for attempt,d in enumerate(pub["training_decisions"],1):
  if d.get("explicit_noop"):continue
  assert d["attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]==csha(bank)
  if not d["accepted"]:continue
  proposal=d["proposed_bank"];composed=compose_legal_edits(bank,proposal,d["legal_edit_coordinates"],d["accepted_legal_coordinates"])
  assert csha(composed)==csha(d["candidate"])
  coords=legal_edit_coordinates(bank,proposal,seen);assert coords==d["legal_edit_coordinates"]
  proposal_records={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in d.get("proposed_replay",d["actual_replay"])}
  actual=d["actual_replay"];assert {(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in actual}=={(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in seen}
  counts=collections.Counter();groups={};stage=f"b{batch}_candidate{attempt}_composed_replay"
  for record in actual:
   key=record["case_id"],record["family"];row=row_by[key]
   assert record["stage"]==stage and record["bank_sha256"]==csha(composed)
   inp=run/"native"/stage/f"{key[0]}_{key[1]}_candidate.input.json"
   ans=inp.with_name(inp.name.replace(".input.json",".answer.json"))
   saved=rd(ans);assert {k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!="score"}==saved
   delivered=rd(inp);expected=payload(row,composed)
   assert delivered["messages"]==expected["messages"] and delivered["schema"]==expected["schema"]
   origin=raw(record["raw_call_path"]);request=origin["calls"][0]["request"]
   actual_wire={"messages":request["messages"],"schema":request["response_format"]["json_schema"]["schema"],
     "generation":cfg["generation"]}
   assert actual_wire==expected
   for field in ("model","temperature","top_p","top_k","max_tokens","seed"):
    assert request[field]==cfg["generation"][field]
   alias=record["physical_alias_of_identical_wire"]
   assert alias["not_an_independent_generation"] is True and alias["raw_call_path"]==record["raw_call_path"]
   assert alias["fingerprint"]==csha(expected)
   assert not inp.with_name(inp.name.replace(".input.json",".json")).exists()
   assert origin["stage"]!=stage
   J=allowable_namespaces(row)
   owners=[c for c in coords if c["task"]==key[1] and J&set(c["jurisdictions"])]
   assert len(owners)==1 and J<=set(owners[0]["jurisdictions"])
   coordinate=owners[0];choose_proposal=coordinate["id"] in d["accepted_legal_coordinates"]
   chosen_bank=proposal if choose_proposal else bank
   chosen_record=proposal_records[key] if choose_proposal else observations[key]
   assert payload(row,chosen_bank)==expected
   assert chosen_record["raw_call_path"]==record["raw_call_path"]
   if key[0] not in targets:
    path=root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f"{key[0]}.json";targets[key[0]]=rd(path)["targets"];evidence.add(str(path.relative_to(root)))
   value=json.loads(origin["response"]["content"]);validate(value,expected["schema"])
   native=decode_asset_references(value,public_asset_catalog(row));catalog=public_catalog(row)
   answer=({asset:[{"citation":decode_reference(claim["citation_ref"],catalog),"claim_value":claim["claim_value"]} for claim in claims] for asset,claims in native.items()}
     if key[1]=="EV" else decode_classification(native,catalog))
   assert record["parsed"]=={"answer":answer} and record["parse_error"] is None
   assert csha(evaluate(row,answer,targets[key[0]][key[1]]))==csha(record["score"])==csha(chosen_record["score"])
   parent=observations[key];candidate=proposal_records[key]
   cohort="current" if key[0] in current_ids else "prior"
   group=groups.setdefault((cohort,key[1]),[])
   group.append({"coordinate":coordinate["id"],"chosen":choose_proposal,
    "parent":parent["score"],"proposal":candidate["score"],"actual":record["score"]})
   counts["proposal_side" if choose_proposal else "parent_side"]+=1
   evidence.update((str(inp.relative_to(root)),str(ans.relative_to(root)),record["raw_call_path"]))
  equations=[]
  for (cohort,family),group in groups.items():
   for endpoint in ("f1","full_output_f1"):
    actual_delta=sum(g["actual"][endpoint]-g["parent"][endpoint] for g in group)/len(group)
    components={}
    for item in group:components.setdefault(item["coordinate"],[]).append(item)
    weighted_delta=0
    for cid,items in components.items():
     assert len({g["chosen"] for g in items})==1
     if items[0]["chosen"]:
      weighted_delta+=sum(g["proposal"][endpoint]-g["parent"][endpoint] for g in items)/len(group)
    assert abs(actual_delta-weighted_delta)<1e-12
    equations.append({"cohort":cohort,"family":family,"endpoint":endpoint,"tasks":len(group),

  total+=len(actual)
  rescued=not d["proposed_whole_bank_acceptance"]["accepted"]
  if rescued:rescued_total+=len(actual)
  audits.append({"batch":batch,"attempt":attempt,"tasks":len(actual),"selection":dict(counts),
   "all_rows_choose_one_predeclared_public_context_component_side":True,
   "all_full_requests_original_origins_fresh_decodes_and_scores_exact":True,
   "native_generations_for_composed_stage":0,"whole_proposal_gate_would_reject":rescued,
   "mean_decomposition_checks":equations})
  bank=composed;observations={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in actual}
 latest=observations;assert csha(bank)==pub["bank_sha256"]
assert len(audits)==9 and total==1152 and rescued_total==640
